message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The conflict-detection logic in `_resolve_component_status` compares `disable` (the original input list) against `to_disable` (the newly computed list of all pipes not in `enable`), so a user passing both `enable` and a `disable` list that is a strict subset of the complement will incorrectly raise a ValueError even when the combination is logically consistent (e.g., `enable=['tagger']` with `disable=['parser']` when both parser and tagger are the only other pipes)."}
